title: Qt: unrealistic statistics for Endpoints and Conversations
description:
Opening the Statistics dialog for Endpoints or Conversations after
a display filter was applied leads to zero values for some of the
columns when disabling the checkbox 'Limit to Display Filter'.

When 'Limit to Display Filter' is unchecked, these zero values
should instead be equal to the totals already known to the dialog.

Ping #15940

AI-Assisted: no
